Still needed for launch

  • Real headshots and introduction video. Etan’s supplied portrait is in place. A verified Zorba portrait is still needed; his initials remain an explicit placeholder.

  • Booking destination. Buttons open a clearly labeled preview brief. Connect the agreed calendar, verify a real booking and add the appropriate privacy details.
  • Final copy sign-off. New e-commerce/AI headlines, forest-green palette and periodic-element identity are implementation proposals. Etan’s Claude V1 was interpreted from your spoken review; the underlying Canvas file wasn’t available in this run.
  • Final verification. See the revision report for completed checks. A real booking test remains blocked until a calendar is supplied.

Pricing, percentage residuals and contract terms remain off the site: those were exploratory and not agreed as public offers. The live site is public. This revision is held for review and has not been published.
